newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms ahead weekend and on monthly reserves.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms ahead weekend and on monthly reserves.

text.p: The rouble edged up on Friday as banks sought funds to invest over the weekend and make monthly reserve payments at the central bank, dealers said.
"Overnight credit rates have firmed as it is profitable for banks to invest roubles for the three days. Besides, today is the last day to set aside roubles for compulsory reserves," one dealer said.
Monthly compulsory reserves must be transferred to the central bank by the fifth calendar day of the following month.
Overnight rouble credits yielded 15-20 percent compared with an early 5-15 percent and Thursday's late 10-20 percent.
United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said peak demand for roubles had already passed with the quarter- and month-end when banks needed roubles square balance sheets.
"The dollar is firming two-three points daily in line with the central bank's policy... but rouble demand could rise next week given the current rise of Treasury bill yields," he said.
Roubles for today settlement were quoted at 5,415-16 per dollar compared with an early 5,420-23 and 5,419-22 late on Thursday. Tomorrow roubles were steady at 5,421-24 per dollar.
The central bank said it had set 5,413/5,425 as its bid and offer rates against the dollar on Friday.
